audit.name: Notes platform growth audit
audit.question: Can a single workspace hold half a million notes, and what gives way first?

repos.name: notes-api
known_gaps: The search indexer runs as a separate service that is not in scope.

repos.name: notes-ops
known_gaps: Autoscaling settings live in the hosting console, not in this repo.

known_limits: Edge proxy rejects request bodies over 2 MiB
Edge proxy closes idle connections after 90 s
The search service returns at most 1000 hits per query
library_assumptions: Job queue: a failed job keeps its id until it is removed, so re-adding with the same id is a no-op
HTTP client: no request timeout unless one is set

groups.scope: src/jobs/ and the queue set-up in src/queue/
groups.focus: Retries, duplicate notifications, jobs that never finish.
Whole-file reads and per-row queries during note imports.
Queries on notes and users that no index serves; unbounded result sets.

groups.scope: src/main.ts, health checks, shutdown handling, read together with the notes-ops manifests
groups.focus: Memory limits, connection pools and what happens during a rolling deploy.
Lists that render or fetch every note of a workspace at once.
